name: StandardClassBPositionReport
description: Standard Class B equipment position report (ITU-R M.1371 message 18) relayed by aisstream.io. Class B 'CS' and 'SO' shipborne mobile equipment use it to report position, speed and course over ground; it also advertises the unit's display, DSC, band and Message 22 capabilities. Derived from the aisstream.io feeder schema published in the xRegistry catalogue. The sample demonstrates a moving vessel as the feature of interest, a coordinateReferenceSystem binding over the reported latitude/longitude pair, an irregular cadence on the position-fix time, the distinction between phenomenonTime and ingestionTime, measured observationValue members for the motion channels, resultQuality members for the decoder and position-integrity flags, and status members for the unit's operating mode.

UserID.description: Maritime Mobile Service Identity (MMSI) of the transmitting station - the nine-digit identity of the vessel or station whose position, speed and course this report describes.

TimeReceived.description: Instant at which the aisstream.io ingest service received and decoded the AIS sentence, taken from the time_utc member of the message envelope. It follows the position fix by the propagation and queueing delay of the terrestrial receiver network.

Timestamp.description: UTC second of the minute (0-59) at which the report was generated by the originating station's electronic position-fixing system; 60 = time stamp not available (default), 61 = positioning system in manual input mode, 62 = positioning system in dead-reckoning mode, 63 = positioning system inoperative. It is the phenomenon time of the position fix, expressed to second-of-minute resolution only; the enclosing minute is recovered from the receipt time.

Valid.description: aisstream.io decoder flag: true = the AIS sentence was decoded successfully and the fields in this message are reliable; false = the message could not be fully decoded.

Latitude.description: Latitude of the reported position in WGS-84 decimal degrees, north positive (range -90 to 90; 91 = position not available).

Longitude.description: Longitude of the reported position in WGS-84 decimal degrees, east positive (range -180 to 180; 181 = position not available).

PositionAccuracy.description: Position accuracy flag: true = high accuracy (better than 10 m, e.g. DGNSS-corrected), false = low accuracy (greater than 10 m, autonomous GNSS).

Raim.description: Receiver Autonomous Integrity Monitoring (RAIM) flag of the position-fixing device: true = RAIM in use, false = RAIM not in use.

Sog.description: Speed over ground in knots (aisstream.io reports the decoded value; AIS native resolution is 0.1 kn, 102.3 = not available).

Cog.description: Course over ground in degrees true (0-359.9; the encoded value 3600, i.e. 360 degrees, means not available).

TrueHeading.description: Heading in degrees true from the vessel's compass or gyro (0-359); 511 = heading not available.

AssignedMode.description: Assigned-mode flag: true = the station's reporting behaviour is controlled by a base station (assigned mode, via message 16/23), false = autonomous mode. Message 18 carries no navigational status field, so the reporting mode is the operating state that this report publishes for the station.

ClassBUnit.description: Class B unit type flag: true = 'CS' (carrier-sense) unit, false = 'SO' (self-organising) unit. The unit type governs the transmission schedule the station follows and is therefore part of its reported operating state.

ClassBDisplay.description: Class B capability flag: true = the unit is equipped with a display showing received AIS messages.

ClassBDsc.description: Class B capability flag: true = the unit is equipped with a DSC (digital selective calling) function.

ClassBBand.description: Class B capability flag: true = the unit can operate over the whole marine band (both AIS channels), false = limited band.

ClassBMsg22.description: Class B capability flag: true = the unit can accept channel-management commands via Message 22, false = not capable.
